subject.title: Memory MVP: add review, edit, forget, and conflict-resolution flows

question: Should this memory MVP proceed as a maintainer-sponsored canonical memory-core lifecycle design now, or wait until the schema/write-pipeline MVP items and Memory Audit direction are settled?
rationale: The remaining work chooses persistence, privacy, operator UX, migration, and the relationship between Dreaming, Memory Audit, memory-wiki, and memory backends; automation cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor canonical lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a maintainer-approved design tying schema, write pipeline, review UI/CLI, forget/tombstone, supersede, conflict resolution, and migration behavior together.

options.title: Narrow to Memory Audit first
options.body: Use the draft Memory Audit PR as the first landing path, but leave this issue open until edit, forget, and conflict lifecycle requirements are covered or split.

options.title: Defer lifecycle MVP
options.body: Keep current dreaming and memory-wiki surfaces as-is until the durable schema and write pipeline are ready for a broader lifecycle pass.

recommendation.title: Sponsor canonical lifecycle design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a maintainer-approved design tying schema, write pipeline, review UI/CLI, forget/tombstone, supersede, conflict resolution, and migration behavior together.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across memory promotion, dreaming docs, and adjacent persistence work among the inspected owners.
